name: RAG Simulator
description: Interactive simulator for understanding Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems - built to help PMs and engineers visualize AI retrieval flows.

name: N8n User Research Automation
description: Automated daily user research workflow that scrapes App Store and Play Store reviews, aggregates feedback, and surfaces themes - eliminating manual research bottlenecks.

name: Vendor ITC Recovery Agent
description: GST reconciliation tool that matches purchase registers against GSTR-2B, flags blocked Input Tax Credit, and drafts vendor follow-up emails for human approval - deterministic matching first, AI arbitration only when genuinely ambiguous.

name: Kwalifier
description: AI-powered bank offer eligibility assistant - tells customers exactly which offers, benefits, and products they qualify for based on their own account data and the bank's official offer catalogue. Grounded in RAG, never speculates.
